data.title: Sick Pay (Krankengeld) Denial by Muster BKK
data.summary: Muster BKK (statutory health insurer) informs David Muster that his claim to sick pay (Krankengeld) is suspended from 12.01.2026 because his incapacity-to-work certificate was not reported within one week, as required by § 49 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 SGB V. The certificate only arrived on 22.01.2026, so Muster BKK will only pay sick pay from that date onward. An objection (Widerspruch) can be filed within one month of notification.
data.explanation: Your health insurer refused to pay statutory sick pay (Krankengeld) for part of your sick leave because the sick note reached them more than a week after your incapacity began — German law requires reporting within one week. As a result, payment only starts from the day the certificate actually arrived. If you believe this is wrong (for example, if you reported it earlier or there were valid reasons for the delay), you can file a written objection (Widerspruch) with Muster BKK by the deadline shown in this record — do not state the exact date yourself, check the computed deadline. If you miss it, the decision becomes final. Consider getting advice from a social law advisor (Sozialverband) or lawyer if you want to dispute this.

key_facts.value: Incapacity not reported within one week (§ 49 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 SGB V)
key_facts.quote: Ihr Anspruch auf Krankengeld ruht, weil die Arbeitsunfähigkeit nicht innerhalb einer Woche gemeldet wurde (§ 49 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 SGB V).

items.title: File objection (Widerspruch) against sick pay denial
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.
items.action: File a written objection (Widerspruch) with Muster BKK, or have it recorded in person (zur Niederschrift), by the deadline shown.

remedy.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.

data.tax_note: Sick pay (Krankengeld) is tax-free but subject to the progression clause (Progressionsvorbehalt) and must be declared in the annual tax return.
